packageName: Blowin' Smoke Security, Privacy, Cryptography, Onion, and Private Wholesale Feasibility and Assurance Gate

findings.reasoning: HTTPS browser commerce can provide the required baseline without a special client.
Only tested controls and qualified claims can support a customer-facing differentiator.
Purpose-specific minimization is feasible, but exact retention depends on legal, accounting, payment, fulfillment, security, and compliance authority.
A pseudonymous identifier is compatible with authentication, but a phone channel alone is insufficient for high-risk access, history, or recovery.

A selectively shared or advertised link can support if-you-know-you-know discovery or inquiry, but it is never room authority and must reveal no private inventory or pricing without an approved account and current grant.

The server can sum eligible quantity by authoritative canonical strain identity; same-strain cross-SKU or package aggregation requires an explicit versioned variant-equivalence policy and distinct strains never aggregate.
Private projections and phone negotiation are feasible, but phone calls are outside the E2EE message boundary and only a canonical quote can become purchasable truth.
Restricted server-authorized delivery can present current evidence-backed records, but media cannot be made uncopyable.
Published protocol families demonstrate endpoint E2EE, but no Blowin' Smoke implementation has been selected or reviewed.
Server blindness is feasible when content keys remain endpoint-held and no readable escrow or silent recipient addition exists.
Mature designs establish these properties; primitives or partial reimplementations do not.
An authenticated trusted endpoint can approve and sign a new endpoint binding.
Account authentication and endpoint key possession can be separate states.
Per-endpoint keys and explicit participant fan-out are established messaging patterns.
A prior order number can locate evidence but is discoverable and cannot serve as the sole secret.
Without a surviving endpoint or independently protected recovery key, the server cannot reconstruct old content keys without contradicting E2EE.
Controlled UI, ciphertext, key, metadata, attachment, notification, backup, and canonical-record lifecycles can be distinct; external copies remain outside control.
A server cannot retract exported, photographed, backed-up, compromised, or otherwise uncontrolled copies.
A web page has no general pre-capture veto over operating-system, browser, or user screenshots.
Installability and service workers do not grant native secure-display authority.
Native platforms expose partial secure-display, detection, or redaction controls with documented coverage limits.
Enterprise device policy can restrict capture on enrolled devices but Blowin' Smoke does not normally control customer BYOD.
No browser, PWA, native, DRM, MDM, or display-affinity control can stop a viewer-controlled external camera.
Authenticated segmented streaming and short authorization can limit unauthorized retrieval, but an authorized client receives renderable content.
Effectiveness depends on encoding pipeline and independent robustness, false-positive, collusion, crop, re-encode, and screen-camera testing.
The server can atomically set first view and deny later requests, but cannot remotely erase already rendered output.
An immutable server deadline and idempotent initiation receipt can remain available after manifest display expires.
Server denial cannot control every client storage, output, capture, or external-camera path.

The Tor v3 protocol mechanism can front an application, but the product entrance remains conditional on origin and resource isolation, canonical parity, key custody, session semantics, operations, and qualified review.
Tor supports isolated Onion routing, but resources, redirects, errors, telemetry, DNS, and operators can still reveal or correlate the origin.
Separate origin state and explicit reauthentication reduce silent linkage, while signing into the same account necessarily creates account correlation.
A high-entropy purpose-bound capability can bootstrap a narrow session, but URL, referrer, history, notification, and log leakage remain bearer-token risks.
Technical gates can express qualified policy, but applicable law, payment-network rules, defects, fraud, and regulatory duties are not established here.
Separate versioned wholesale serviceability rules are supported, but actual legal eligibility, inventory, routes, capacity, providers, and economics are absent.
Customer delivery charge can be zero while internal delivery cost and subsidy remain separately recorded.
Existing field-level provenance and explicit UNKNOWN semantics support evidence-bounded wholesale publication.

mediaDecision.reasoning: Catalog media requires current revocation, merchandising, streaming, controlled delivery, and provider-aware operations; E2EE remains appropriate for designated conversation content.
